global_boundary: No case currently supports an allegation of bribery, corruption, favouritism or unlawful influence.

cases.title: DVAG donations and private-pension reform
cases.core_finding: Political spending and institutional proximity are verified, while the strongest observable BDV demands were rejected or met with stricter consumer-cost safeguards.
cases.prohibited_inference: Donations caused, bought or altered the law.

cases.title: Amazon and the 2026 UVgO reform
cases.core_finding: A documented overlap exists on higher direct-award thresholds, but multiple organisations sought increases and marketplace-specific adoption is not established.
cases.prohibited_inference: Amazon authored or improperly caused the reform.

cases.title: Germany's GRECO status after 31 March 2026
cases.core_finding: No newer German fifth-round compliance publication is publicly listed as of the research freeze, leaving the post-deadline status publicly unverifiable.
cases.prohibited_inference: Germany failed to submit its report.

cases.title: Berlin procurement transparency
cases.core_finding: Visible ex-post notices commonly omit price, bid count and detailed justification, limiting defensible competition and value-for-money review.
cases.prohibited_inference: A non-open procedure is corrupt or unlawful.

cases.title: Bundestag outside-interest data fragmentation
cases.core_finding: Detailed disclosure rules coexist with a fragmented technical publication model that lacks one versioned interest-to-policy dataset.
cases.prohibited_inference: A disclosed interest or policy role proves misconduct.

cases.title: Federal audit follow-through tracker
cases.core_finding: Parliament created concrete reporting deadlines, but acceptance of recommendations must remain separate from publicly verified implementation.
cases.prohibited_inference: A report not located in this review was never submitted or the recommendation was ignored.
